items.a: Standard orders take 24–48 hours from artwork approval. Rush orders can be ready the same day, so tell us your deadline.
No minimums. Order 1 shirt or 1,000; small orders are welcome.
Yes. Send your ideas, logos or rough sketches, and we create the artwork at no extra charge.
Pricing depends on the product, the quantity and how complex the design is. Try the price calculator on the Services page, or ask us for a free quote.

items.q: What file formats do you accept?
items.a: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI, EPS, PSD and SVG. For the sharpest print, send vector files (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF) or images at 300 DPI. If you have no design yet, we create one for you.
Yes. If you’re not happy with the print quality, we reprint your order or refund you. Our refund policy has the details.

items.q: Can I see a proof before printing?
items.a: Yes. We send you a digital proof to approve before production starts, so you know what you’re getting.
Yes. We also offer pickup at our Elgin shop and contactless delivery for local customers.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash, credit cards, PayPal, Venmo and Zelle. Payment is usually due before production starts. Payment plans are available for large orders.
